title: Authentic Amber Irish Cheese Casserole
description: A nutty and crumbly Irish dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese, perfect for a sick day, and Buddhist-temple-friendly as it is vegetarian and uses fermented ingredients.

ingredients.name: Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.notes: preferably fermented for at least 6 months

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion, sliced mushrooms, and chopped celery in melted butter until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked vegetable mixture, cubed sourdough bread, and shredded Monterey Jack cheese.
Season the mixture with dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
